scope: Drill of the 5-sibling FUN_00cf32e0 caller cluster surfaced by the alt-binding-recon pass (manifests/alt_binding_recon.json). Decompiled all 5 templates + 21 impls (Ghidra DumpFunctionDecomp.java batch). Recovered metamethod-name strings via .rdata dword dump at 0x0110ea80..0x0110eb00.

summary.outcomeNote: The 21 impls are metamethod handlers for 5 userdata metatables, not named Lua N-APIs. The cluster is fully accounted for as part of the engine's userdata-metatable binding surface, distinct from the FUN_00cccad0 method-N-API surface that the high-signal-napi-attribution pass family closed.

templates.notes: Full 5-metamethod metatable. __gc impl 0x00d2f330 is LAB_ (tail-call thunk, no function boundary recognized).

Hybrid constructor+metatable template. Caller FUN_00d1ce10 (1943 bytes) pushes the string "BaseClass" twice (at 0x00d1d07d and 0x00d1d1df) - this is a class-registry registration for a Lua-side BaseClass userdata. The 4 FUN_00cf3360 (pushstring) arg addresses inside FUN_00D20B00 are decompiler-stripped and were not recoverable via direct operand inspection. Likely loaded from struct fields or via register-relative addressing the static dump path doesn't follow. Names would need PCode-level analysis or runtime hook (live capture) to recover.

labOnlyImplsNote: All 5 LAB_ impls occupy the __gc slot of their respective metatable (or slot3 of D20B00). They are tail-call thunks - no Ghidra function boundary - that almost certainly JMP into the userdata destructor / free path. The dat-prefix-attribution pass documented the &LAB_ / &DAT_ prefix-mode issue in the widened-attribution pass's regex; this confirms the LAB_ pattern surfaces in a third domain (metatable __gc thunks) beyond the FUN_00cccad0 method-N-API surface where the dat-prefix-attribution pass first saw it.
